blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the President (OP) is seriously considering granting absolute pardon to Mary Jane Veloso, who has been detained for over a decade for alleged drug trafficking, Bataan Rep. Albert Garcia said on Wednesday. During the House sponsorship and plenary deliberations for the proposed budget of the OP for next year, Gabriela party-list Rep. Sarah Elago asked Garcia on the measures of the OP to ensure Veloso’s immediate freedom. READ: Mandaluyong court allows Mary Jane Veloso to testify in detention Garcia is the budget sponsor of the OP. Executive Secretary Ralph Recto was also present during the […]...
